entry.title: dotnet/runtime - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-11-01
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • ExitCode_VoidMainAppReturnsSetValue expected 123, actual 122 #136807
  • EventPipe in native AOT WASM #136806
    12.0.0
  • SetILInstrumentedCodeMap frees the previous map while another thread may still be reading it (use-after-free) #136804
  • Linux: named mutex creation fails with lstat("") when XDG_RUNTIME_DIR is unset (StackString::IsEmpty reads an uninitialized buffer) #136802
  • Deflate64 inflater output window bound is short by two, silently corrupting one attacker-chosen byte of extracted ZIP content in 8.0/9.0/10.0 #136789
  • WinZip AES (AE-2): unverified metadata silently changes what ZipArchive returns, including reading an entry as empty #136787
  • X509Certificate2.MatchesHostname accepts a *.com certificate for any .com host, where SslStream rejects it #136785
  • CurrentCulture ignores the script in a POSIX locale modifier: sr_RS@latin resolves to Cyrillic #136781
  • [wasm][AOT] After an exception filter catches, the method's arguments read wrong (string empty, int 1) #136780
  • System.Xml.CharCheckingReaderTests.CharCheckingReaderTest fails with OutOfMemoryException #136776

Closed

  • Utf8Parser.TryParse(..., out int, ...) is slower than the other integer overloads because TryParseInt32D is too large to inline #136761
  • [wasm] Emscripten clang wrapper fails when the SDK path contains a space #135416
    Future
